name: Getting comfortable behind the wheel
summary: Small steps to make your first few lessons feel more manageable.
body: Start by adjusting the seat and mirrors while parked. Take a moment to identify the pedals, gear selector and indicators so you can find them without looking down.
Practise one skill at a time with your instructor. A quiet route makes it easier to repeat smooth starts and stops before adding junctions or busier traffic.

name: How to practise parking
summary: A simple routine for low-speed manoeuvres.
body: Pick an open practice area and use clear reference points. Move slowly enough to stop as soon as you lose sight of your surroundings.
Check mirrors and blind spots throughout the manoeuvre. Reset and try again if the angle feels wrong. Ask your instructor to demonstrate from the same starting position.

name: Preparing for your driving test
summary: What to practise before the big day.
body: Practise the full routine from getting into the car to pulling away safely. Build the habit of checking mirrors and signalling before you change position.
Ask your instructor for a mock drive with fewer prompts. Make a short list of the manoeuvres that still need practice and confirm current test requirements with your local licensing office.

name: Can I start with no driving experience?
summary: Yes. The learner programme is designed around fundamentals like setting up the car, working the controls and building confidence step by step.

name: How much do lessons cost?
summary: Use the course enquiry form to request the current fee, number of sessions and any additional charges for your chosen programme.

name: Can I learn in an automatic car?
summary: Mention your preferred transmission when you enquire so the school can confirm the vehicles available for your lessons.

name: Can I get help with my driving licence?
summary: Choose RTO Licence Assistance when you enquire and specify whether you need help with a learner licence, practical test or two-wheeler licence.

name: Can I book a refresher lesson?
summary: Choose the Advanced & Refresher Programme and tell us what you want to practise, such as parking, junctions or driving in heavy traffic.
